name: Polygon Paths
tagline: Roll, move, and prove — a board race where every step must be justified with a geometry fact.

steps.title: Choose your token
steps.text: Each player picks a shape token and places it on START. Draw a Path card — it names the polygon zone you must reach first.

steps.title: Roll and move
steps.text: Roll the die and move that many tiles along the path. You may split the move across junctions — geometry is about choices.

steps.title: Prove to proceed
steps.text: Landing on a checkpoint tile means drawing a Proof card: state the angle rule or property that applies. Correct proof = take a shortcut tile. Wrong proof = stay put.

steps.title: Collect shapes
steps.text: Each completed zone awards that zone's shape token — triangle, quadrilateral, pentagon, hexagon. Collect all four to unlock the final gate.

steps.title: The final gate
steps.text: At the gate, solve the Pythagoras puzzle printed on the board edge for your lane. First correct solution wins the race.

steps.title: Team variant
steps.text: For classrooms, play in pairs — one player navigates, one proves, swapping roles at every checkpoint.

challenges.title: Rules Master
challenges.brief: Answer five consecutive Proof cards correctly without hints — angles on a line, in a triangle, at a point, vertically opposite, and in an isosceles triangle.

challenges.title: Shape Sorter
challenges.brief: Correctly classify all four zone polygons by both side count and angle type, within one turn.

challenges.title: Triple Proof
challenges.brief: Solve another player's final-gate Pythagoras puzzle in under two minutes — right triangle, missing hypotenuse, and missing leg.

challenges.title: Area Ace
challenges.brief: Compute the perimeter and area of your zone's shape from the measurements on the Proof card, with no calculator.

scorecard.scoring: 2 points per correct proof, 5 per zone token, plus printed challenge points. Fastest final-gate solution earns a 10-point bonus.
